changelog:
v4.2.10 — Fixes live TV rebuffering every 2 minutes + Home screen freezes

• Fixes live channels freezing for a second or two every couple of minutes, over and over, even on a fast connection. The app was mistakenly deciding a live channel had 'ended' and restarting it on a timer — roughly every 2 minutes, all night. Live TV now runs straight through. This also applies to MultiView and the channel preview.

• Fixes the app freezing on the Home screen, usually right after opening it, where it stops responding to the remote and Fire TV offers to close it. Three separate pieces of Home screen work were running on the wrong thread and blocking the remote: the genre row sorting, building the genre rows themselves, and the quality badge on every poster card. All three are fixed.

Includes all v4.2.9 (buffering, stall recovery, stats) and v4.2.4-4.2.8 (4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby audio, freeze/ANR, 4K binge) fixes.
